title: Real BMW M5 3D model and clearer mobile studio
summary: Integrated SQUIR3D?s official interactive BMW M5 F90 2021 embed instead of the empty asset panel. Added real camera reset and material-based paint controls; compact mobile layout and corrected RTL units.

Prioritized a larger 3D viewport, collapsed Competition reference specs, fixed Latin units in RTL, and replaced oversized white Changes Made button.
Ready/error handling, retry, camera reset framing, body-only paint changes when supported, viewport/background pause and disposal.
